# dsh-client-ui-model-seat
**English** · 中文

The model + thinking control of the dsh composer, merged from two plugins that
both replaced the sam
e seat and therefore could not be installed together:

- **dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper** — the shell: token-driven colours, the particle
thinking slider, the

appearance panel, the i18n dictionaries and the
per-session wiring.
- **dsh-model-provider-prefix**

— the skeleton of the card: a provider column
beside a model column, hover decides which provider th

e model column shows,
and a failed provider turns into a retry row.
Use this one **instead of** either original — not beside them:

dsh plugin remove dsh-client-ui-gpt-helper
dsh plugin remove dsh-model-provider-prefix

Maintaining this file: see MAINTENANCE.md (Chinese) for the
code map, the invariants that keep the c

ard stable, the test matrix and the
real-app verification recipes. Changes per release: CHANGELOG.md

rd stable, the test matrix and the
real-app verification recipes. Changes per release: CHANGELOG.md.
Who it is for / 适用场景:
| You are… | This plugin gives you |
| Someone who needs the provider next to the model | One trigger showing `provider/model`, one card

with both columns. |
| Someone whose provider list is long | Hover the provider column; the model co

lumn swaps and the card stays put. |
| Someone who tunes reasoning effort | The effort trigger and i

ts particle slider; the drift on the track is always running. |
| Someone carrying both original plu
gins | One seat instead of two that cannot coexist. |

Requires dsh `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (`engines.dsh`). Client-side only: no network calls,
no credential acce

2.1-rc.2` (`engines.dsh`). Client-side only: no network calls,
no credential access, no host module.
## What it does
| Surface | Behaviour |
| Model trigger | `provider/model` as one run of text, plus a caret. Opens the card on the provider+
model columns; a second click closes it. When the composer row already names the provider — dsh-prov
iders-hub's JetHub badge sits in `conversation.input.right` beside the seat — the trigger drops its

own prefix and shows the model alone, so the provider is printed once. |
| Effort trigger | The curr
ent thinking level (`Max`, `Medium`, …). Opens the card on the particle slider; rendered only when t

he selected model declares thinking levels. |
| Provider column | Every provider in the session dire
ctory with its model count, a check on the current provider, and a retry row for a provider whose li

st failed to load. |
| Model column | Head shows the provider under the pointer; a 30 px search box
sits inside the column. Hovering the provider column swaps the models **without moving the card**. |
| Search | Typing searches **every** provider at once and shows the provider name on each row. The
card keeps its two-column shape while typing — a re-shaping card is exactly the resize flicker this

plugin removes. |
| Thinking slider | The particle slider from the shell, over the level ladder of t

he selected model, with keyboard arrows/Home/End. |
| Thinking head | The current level on the left
(click it to return to the two columns), a bolt that jumps to the highest level and back to the one

you left, and a reset button that restores the model's default level. |
| Appearance panel | `Ctrl+S
hift+Alt+G`. Colour tokens per side (light/dark), scheme library, JSON import/export, reset, cross-a
pply to the other side, live preview. |

Geometry: the card is `416 px` wide in the column layout and `300 px` in the
thinking panel, both cl

amped to the viewport. Each layout keeps its own floor —
eight model rows, i.e. `333 px`, for the co

lumns and `96 px` for the thinking
panel — so the card never drops below its own body, and both cap

at `420 px`.
The card flips above the trigger when that gives more room.
## The flicker this merge had to fix

The upstream card was anchored by its **bottom** edge and sized by its
**content**, while its conten

t was chosen by the **row under the pointer**. With
one provider holding more models than the card c
ould show, that closed a loop:

1. the card grows to fit the model list, so its top edge moves up;
2. the pointer, which was over a

provider row, is now over a different row (or
outside the card), so the model column swaps or emptie
t **27 height flips in 900 ms** on the old bundle.

The merged card breaks the loop by making the frame a function of the anchor and
the layout only:
[该节后续省略]
## Known limitations

- **One seat, one owner.** The plugin registers at `priority: -2` for
`conversation.input.model`. An

other plugin registering the same priority for the
same slot is resolved by mount order, not by this

plugin.
- **No column-to-column keyboard navigation.** Arrows move inside the focused
column (the s

lider, the search box, the rows); Tab leaves the card. Hover and
clicks are the way to change provid

er.
- **The card does not animate.** Switching panes or providers relayouts in one
frame by design —

an animated height is the resize loop this merge removes.
A window resize re-measures the clamp, so

an open card follows the viewport.
- **Colours live in `localStorage`** (`dsh-client-ui-model-seat:

config:v1`) per
browser profile. They do not follow the account across machines; the panel's
JSON im

port/export is the only way to move them.
- **Search covers model name and id, not provider names.**

Typing `ollama` finds
`ollama/qwen` through the model, not through the provider column.
- **Web cli

ent surface only** (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`, which the desktop app
renders). The terminal surfa

ce is untouched.
- **`lib/client.js` is one hand-written file** with no build step; `dsh.client`
tak

es a single `./client` entry. There is no per-model override layer: the
plugin edits the seat, not t

/client` entry. There is no per-model override layer: the
plugin edits the seat, not the model list.
